planLine.comp: Pro is granted to your account at no charge: nothing renews and nothing is billed.
planLine.cancels: Your cancellation is scheduled: Pro stays until {{date}}, and nothing more will be charged.
planLine.pastDue: The last payment didn't go through, and Paddle is retrying it. Update your payment method to keep Pro after {{date}}.
planLine.renews: Renews on {{date}}. Cancel any time; Pro stays until the end of the period you paid for.
planLine.canceled: Your Pro subscription ended. Nothing was deleted, and Pro brings your whole history back.
planLine.paused: Your subscription is paused, so you're on Free until you resume it.
planLine.free: {{analyses}} analyses a month, and your last {{history}} kept in your history.

usage.title: This period
usage.proEnds: Pro ends on {{date}}; Free's allowance applies after that.

signIn.title: Sign-in
signIn.body: Your email, sign-in methods and active sessions are kept by Clerk, our sign-in provider. Changes there apply at once.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.lede: Deleting your account is immediate, and it can't be undone.

removed.analyses: Your analyses, and the CVs you uploaded
removed.interviews: Your interviews, with their transcripts, feedback and translations
removed.voice: The interview conversations at ElevenLabs, our voice provider
removed.billing: Any subscription, canceled at once so nothing more is charged, and your unused interview credits
removed.signIn: Your sign-in at Clerk: email, sign-in methods and sessions

kept.paddle: Paddle, the merchant of record, keeps your invoices, transactions and customer record: they are tax records.
kept.log: A log of billing events (ids, types and times) stays for our accounting, tied only to an account id that no longer exists.

delete.confirmBody: Deleted now: your analyses and CVs; your interviews with their transcripts, feedback and translations; the conversations at our voice provider; any unused credits. Any subscription is canceled at once. Paddle keeps your invoices and customer record as tax records. You'll be signed out, and this can't be undone.
delete.confirmBodySubscribed: Deleted now: your analyses and CVs; your interviews with their transcripts, feedback and translations; the conversations at our voice provider; any unused credits. Your subscription is canceled at once, so Pro ends now, not at the end of the period. Paddle keeps your invoices and customer record as tax records. This can't be undone.
delete.done: Your account is deleted. Signing you out…

interviews.label: Interviews
interviews.creditsCover: Your credits cover full interviews; Pro adds {{perMonth}} a month.
interviews.proOnly: Voice interviews are part of Pro.

trial.label: Free trial interview
trial.availableNote: One {{minutes}}-minute practice interview with the AI interviewer, once per account.
trial.unavailableNote: The free trial is for accounts that have never had Pro or a full interview. Voice interviews are part of Pro.

credits.label: Interview credits
credits.none: From packs of {{size}}; each one a full interview.
credits.pro: Used after the period's interviews. They never expire.
credits.free: Each one is a full {{minutes}}-minute interview, on any plan. They never expire.
credits.pending_one: {{count}} credit pending return: an interview is still open. If nothing was answered, it comes back within minutes of the call ending.
credits.pending_other: {{count}} credits pending return: an interview is still open. If nothing was answered, it comes back within minutes of the call ending.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.offer: Pro is {{price}} a month: {{interviews}} voice interviews of up to {{minutes}} minutes, up to {{analyses}} analyses and your whole history.

packs.title: Interview packs
packs.proOnly: Packs of {{count}} more interviews are sold with Pro. Credits you already hold work on any plan.

portalNote: “Manage subscription” opens Paddle, the merchant of record: payment method, invoices and cancellation live there. Cancelling keeps Pro until the end of the period you paid for.

activation.waitingPro: Activating your plan… Your payment went through; the confirmation from Paddle usually takes a few seconds.
activation.waitingPack: Adding your credits… Your payment went through; the confirmation from Paddle usually takes a few seconds.
activation.stalled: Your payment is confirmed by Paddle but hasn’t reached us yet. It will appear shortly; you can refresh later.
activation.notYet: Not here yet. Paddle has the payment; it will appear shortly.
